comments.text:
Implement ChannelStrip Vizia view combining volume fader, pan, mute/solo, sends, EQ, and category icon.

DEPENDS ON: i7-49c.7 (SynthKnob for sends), i7-49c.8 (SynthSwitch for mute), i7-49c.9 (VolumeFader, PanKnob)

VARIANTS: part (full controls), ext (level+mute only), master (level+EQ), comp-eq (compressor+EQ)

FOR PART VARIANT:
- Channel select dropdown (receive channel 1-16)
- EQ section (collapsible)
- Pan knob
- FX1/FX2 send knobs (or AMB knob when surround enabled)
- Mute (M) and Solo (S) buttons with colored active states
- C+EQ assign button
- Volume fader with vertical tone name
- Category icon + label below fader

The part variant reads from the shared DeviceState and calls setters on user interaction.

REFERENCE:
- web/src/ChannelStrip.tsx: full React implementation (322 lines)
- web/src/ChannelStrip.module.css: visual styling
- web/src/categoryIcons.ts: SVG icons for tone categories and strip roles

Place in crates/integral-vst/src/views/.

title: VST/Vizia: implement ChannelStrip with level, pan, mute, solo, sends
